name: DMS Packaging
about:
DMS Packaging, a family-owned packaging company headquartered in Elk Grove Village, Illinois, draws on over 40 years of print, fulfillment, and distribution experience. The business was established to provide co-packing and fulfillment services with a consultative approach.

The company specializes in blister packaging, lot coding, collation, shrink-wrapping, bagging, gluing, flexible packaging, hand assembly, kitting, fulfillment services, and distribution. It offers turn-key solutions or works with customer-provided materials, operating high-speed machinery to handle both high- and low-volume projects. Facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

DMS serves customers ranging from the world’s largest printers and marketing companies to small businesses needing specialized packaging services. Its client base spans industries that require co-packing, order fulfillment, and distribution support.

The company emphasizes competitive pricing, quick turnaround, and a consultative approach that simplifies packaging requirements. Differentiators include a full-time dedicated workforce, consistent on-time performance, 30-plus years of sourcing and design experience, and flexibility to customize services for projects of any size.
